nodes.description: Mapping of token balances for every account; private _owned.
Nested mapping of owner/spender approved amounts.
Mapping flagging accounts exempt from buy/sell fees.
Mapping flagging addresses blocked from transferring.
Immutable constant total supply of 1e9 * 10**9 tokens.
Reference to the Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity.
Payable address receiving collected ETH fees.
Address of the created token/WETH liquidity pair.
Buy fee percentage applied to purchases from the pair.
Sell fee percentage applied to sells to the pair.
Impact fee percentage used to cap the swappable contract balance.
Maximum amount purchasable during the launch anti-bot window.
Maximum amount an account may hold during the launch window.
Timestamp recorded when trading is opened.
Boolean flag indicating whether trading has been enabled.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Flag enabling dynamic capping of the swapped contract balance.
Owner address stored by the Ownable contract.
Private core transfer routine performing bot checks, launches limits, fee-on-transfer swap and ETH distribution.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that transfers then decrements and rewrites the allowance.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve for msg.sender.
Private allowance setter that validates non-zero owner and spender.
Private swap of contract tokens into ETH via the router using the lockTheSwap guard.
Private transfer of the contract ETH balance to the fee collection address.
Private helper that resolves the applicable fee and forwards to _transferStandard.
Private view selecting buy or sell fee, or zero when the fee is waived.
Private balance update routine subtracting from sender, crediting recipient and taking the team fee.
Private pure computation of the team fee and the net transfer amount.
Private accumulation of the team fee into the contract balance.
Owner-only creation of the Uniswap V2 pair and router configuration.
Owner-only function adding liquidity, approving the pair and enabling trading with launch limits.
Unrestricted external function swapping the entire contract token balance for ETH.
Unrestricted external function sending the entire contract ETH balance to the fee address.
Owner-only setter of the impact fee rate with an extra fee-address equality check.
Owner-only setter reducing buy and sell fees.
Owner-only toggle of the impact fee setter flag.
Owner-only update of the fee collection address.
Owner-only batch marking of addresses as bots.
Owner-only batch clearing of bot flags.
Owner-only renouncement of ownership setting the owner to the zero address.
Constructor initializing fee address, supply, owner and fee exemptions.
Public view returning the stored balance of an account.
Public view returning the contract token balance.
Public view returning the token balance held by the liquidity pair.
Public view exposing the bot flag of an address.
Receive hook accepting plain ETH transfers into the contract.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address used for ownership and authorization.
block.timestamp, the miner-influenced time value used for launch limits, deadlines and launch recording.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens transferring control to an external contract.
ETH transfer to the externally controllable _FeeCollectionADD address, which may be a contract.
External payable call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH using the whole contract ETH balance.
External call granting maximum allowance of the pair token to the router.
External call to the Uniswap factory createPair returning an unverified pair address.
Arithmetic on balances and fee percentages in _getValues and _transferStandard that can revert or mis-account values.
Parameter from of _transfer, the source address of the token movement.
Parameter to of _transfer, the destination address of the token movement.
Parameter amount of _transfer, the number of tokens to move.
Parameter tokenAmount of swapTokensForEth, the amount of tokens swapped into ETH.
Parameter amount of sendETHToFee, the ETH value forwarded to the fee address.
Parameter amount of the public transfer entry point.
Parameter amount of transferFrom, the approved amount being spent.
Parameter sender of transferFrom, the account whose allowance is consumed.
Parameter spender of approve, the account receiving the allowance.
Array parameter bots_ of setBots listing addresses to flag as bots.
Parameter rate of setFeeRate, the new impact fee percentage.
Parameter buy of setFees, the new buy fee percentage.
Parameter sell of setFees, the new sell fee percentage.
Parameter newAddress of updateTaxAdd, the new fee collection address.
Local boolean isBuy in _transfer tracking whether the transfer originates from the pair.
Local boolean takeFee in _transfer deciding whether a fee is applied.
Local contractTokenBalance in _transfer holding the amount eligible for swapping.
Local contractETHBalance in _transfer holding the ETH to distribute.
Local address array path in swapTokensForEth defining the swap route.
Local team in _getValues, the computed fee amount.
Local transferAmount in _getValues, the net amount credited to the recipient.
Local fee in _getFee holding the selected fee percentage.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount into the private _transfer routine.
transferFrom() forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
approve() delegates the allowance write to the private _approve function.
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads the current allowance and rewrites it after the transfer.
msg.sender is used as the from address of the public transfer entry point.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender acts as the allowance owner in approve.
_transfer consumes the amount parameter for balance checks and fee computation.
_transfer reads and enforces the _isBot blacklist for the sender.
_transfer compares from and to against the uniswapV2Pair address to detect buys and sells.
_transfer requires _tradingOpen before processing pair-related transfers.
_transfer reads _launchedAt to enforce the launch anti-bot window.
block.timestamp gates the three-minute launch window checks, enabling timestamp dependency manipulation.
_transfer enforces the _maxBuyTokens purchase limit during the launch window.
_transfer enforces the _maxHeldTokens holding limit during the launch window.
_transfer reads and writes the _inSwap flag through the lockTheSwap modifier.
_transfer reads _useImpactFeeSetter to decide whether to cap the swapped balance.
_transfer reads _feeRate when computing the impact-capped swap amount.
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFee for both sender and recipient to waive fees.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth which performs an external router swap in the middle of the transfer flow.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which transfers ETH to the fee address during the same transaction.
_transfer delegates the final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer resolves the applicable fee percentage through _getFee.
_tokenTransfer performs the actual balance movement through _transferStandard.
_transferStandard derives the net amount and team fee from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team fee through _takeTeam.
_transferStandard decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance in _owned.
_transferStandard performs unchecked-style balance subtraction and addition that constitute the contract's arithmetic surface.
The arithmetic operation writes the resulting values back into the _owned mapping.
_getValues computes the team fee amount from the amount and teamFee inputs.
_getValues computes the net transferAmount as amount minus team.
_getFee reads the _buyFee percentage for buy-side transfers.
_getFee reads the _sellFee percentage for sell-side transfers.
_takeTeam adds the collected fee into the contract balance entry of _owned.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap forwarding control to an untrusted contract.
swapTokensForEth calls the stored uniswapV2Router for WETH and the swap.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp directly as the swap deadline parameter.
swapTokensForEth sets and clears the _inSwap guard through lockTheSwap.
A malicious router or pair can reenter _transfer during the external swap callback.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer that hands control to the recipient.
sendETHToFee uses the _FeeCollectionADD state variable as the transfer destination.
If the fee recipient is a contract it can reenter manualsend or receive, draining the ETH balance.
openTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH call forwarding ETH and control to the router.
openTrading makes an external approve call on the pair token.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline and stores it as the launch time.
openTrading stores the resulting pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading approves and calls the previously configured router.
openTrading approves the full _totalSupply to the router.
The router could reenter openTrading or other functions during the liquidity addition.
createPair calls the external Uniswap factory createPair function.
createPair stores the factory-returned address in uniswapV2Pair without verification.
createPair reads factory() and WETH() from the hardcoded router.
createPair is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares _owner against msg.sender.
openTrading is guarded by onlyOwner relying on msg.sender.
manualswap is externally callable by any msg.sender with no owner or bot restriction.
manualswap triggers swapTokensForEth and therefore the external router swap with no guard.
manualsend is externally callable by any msg.sender allowing forced ETH distribution.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee which performs the external ETH transfer.
setFeeRate is owner guarded and additionally requires the caller to equal _FeeCollectionADD.
setFeeRate writes the supplied rate into _feeRate.
setFees is owner guarded through msg.sender comparison.
setFees writes the new buy fee into _buyFee.
setFees writes the new sell fee into _sellFee.
toggleImpactFee is owner guarded through msg.sender.
toggleImpactFee writes the new flag into _useImpactFeeSetter.
updateTaxAdd is owner guarded through msg.sender.
updateTaxAdd writes the new payable address into _FeeCollectionADD.
setBots is owner guarded through msg.sender.
setBots writes true into the _isBot mapping for each supplied address.
delBots is owner guarded through msg.sender.
delBots clears the _isBot flags for the supplied addresses.
renounceOwnership is owner guarded through onlyOwner and _msgSender.
renounceOwnership sets the _owner state variable to the zero address.
The constructor assigns the deploy-time argument to _FeeCollectionADD.
The constructor sets the deployer as _owner.
The constructor mints the fixed total supply to the contract address in _owned.
The constructor marks the owner, the contract and the tax address as fee exempt.
balanceOf reads the account balance from the _owned mapping.
thisBalance returns the contract's own entry of the _owned mapping.
amountInPool returns the token balance held by the uniswapV2Pair address.
isBot exposes the _isBot mapping entry of an arbitrary address.
Any msg.sender can query the bot status of any address.
The _FeeCollectionADD address is the recipient of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
setFeeRate compares the caller against the _FeeCollectionADD state variable.
block.timestamp is stored into _launchedAt, anchoring all launch-window logic on miner-controllable time.
_transfer calls owner() to bypass fee and launch logic for the owner's transfers.
_approve writes the allowance for msg.sender derived owner/spender pairs in approve and transferFrom.
